transcript.text: I need to flag a permit issue before we approve the protocol. I received the city event permit after the draft packet was circulated — it authorizes the red carpet only in the East Arcade, not the Main Plaza. It also requires a 2.4-meter clear pedestrian lane, not the two meters in the draft, and it permits the adjacent public walkway to be closed from 5:30 PM to 9:30 PM. I haven't uploaded it yet because the city sent the signed PDF to the festival's general permits mailbox, but I have it in hand.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to report a security requirement from my walk-through. Guest vehicles must use the North Service Court, where only one vehicle can unload at a time without blocking the emergency access route. This directly conflicts with the draft protocol's south drive drop-off plan. I recorded this in my shift log but hadn't circulated it yet.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: I need to report an accessibility requirement from my inspection. The usable step-free guest route is through the West Entrance, with a portable ramp deployed before arrivals and a 1.8-meter clear route maintained to the accessible press position. The venue's facilities contact sent this confirmation directly to me.
transcript.speaker: A4

transcript.text: I need to report a publicity requirement. I reviewed the lead actor's signed publicity rider with the distributor this afternoon. It permits still photography at the arrival but prohibits live video coverage of the arrival, and the approved arrival images may be released at exactly 7:15 PM. This conflicts with the draft protocol's mixed live-and-still press pool. I'm still waiting for the distributor's written email before I update the press brief, but the rider is signed and binding.
transcript.speaker: A5
